remarks: Charming Single-Story Home with Great Potential  &  NO HOA! Welcome to this inviting 3 bed + 2 bath home, that has been cherished by the same family for 47 years! Tucked away on a cul-de-sac and offering comfort, convenience, and exciting opportunity. Freshly painted, this home features a separate office, individual laundry room, cozy fireplace, solar, water softener, along with a new water heater and newer A/C and furnace. The functional floor plan offers a wonderful foundation for personal touches and updates to make the space your own.
